name: How long does a restucco project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a restucco project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a restucco project depends on several factors, including the size of the home, the complexity of the architectural details, weather conditions, and the extent of any necessary repairs. On average, a complete restucco can take anywhere from one to three weeks from start to finish. This timeframe includes preparation, application of multiple stucco layers, and crucial drying times between coats. A detailed timeline can be provided after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A restucco project typically takes one to three weeks, depending on home size, complexity, and weather. This includes preparation, application of multiple layers, and drying times.
